title: Haryana HPSC (Executive Branch) & Other Allied Services Recruitment 2026 Mains Result
postName: Haryana HCS (Executive Branch) & Other Allied Services – Mains Result 2026
vacancyDetails: HPSC Haryana Civil Services Examination 2026 Mains result declared for Executive Branch and other allied services posts across 102 vacancies.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university in India.
ageLimit: 18–27 years for DSP and 18–42 years for other posts; age relaxation as per HPSC rules.
applicationFee: Male General ₹1000; Haryana reserved category ₹250; all Haryana female category ₹250; PH ₹0.
selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview / Personality Test → Final selection
documentsRequired: Roll number, registration details, educational certificates, category certificate, identity proof and related verification documents
howToApply:
1. Visit the official HPSC portal.
2. Open the result or HCS mains result PDF.
3. Search by roll number / name.
4. Download the result and check qualification status.
5. Follow document verification or next-step instructions if shortlisted.
shortDescription: Haryana HPSC HCS Mains Result 2026 is out. Download the Executive Branch and allied services result from the official HPSC portal.
content:
Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the HCS Mains Result 2026 for the Executive Branch and other Allied Services recruitment.

Applicants who appeared in the HCS 2026 mains exam can now check the result notice and shortlist status on the official HPSC portal.

The recruitment includes multiple civil service posts under the Haryana Civil Services exam and the result is available through the HPSC official website and result PDF link.
